name: Champion Medal
description: A medal of pure gold, awarded to trainers who have defeated the Elite Four and the Champion of the Omuran League.

name: Stine Stone
description: A manufactured Fusion Stone. Have Porygon hold it, and this stone will enable it to Fusion Evolve in battle.

name: Reaper Stone
description: One variety of the mysterious Mega Stones. Have Omuran Ursaring hold it, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.

name: TM102
description: The user attacks by shooting out muddy water. It may also lower the foe's accuracy.

name: Gas Mask
description: A Gas Mask. It converts toxic fumes into breathable air.

name: Shuckle Stone
description: Mysterious stone that brings sexy back.

name: Rainbow Orb
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the power of moves, and heals some HP on each hit.

name: Ashy's Heart
description: A chocolate heart given to you by Ashy as a sign of affection.

name: Silver Key
description: A mysterious silver key of completely unknown purpose.

name: Zircon Key
description: A mysterious zircon key of completely unknown purpose.

name: Quartz Key
description: A mysterious quartz key of completely unknown purpose.

name: Quartz Card
description: Boosts all stats by 2x.

name: Old Cellphone
description: A decades-old cellphone. It seems to be barely working.

name: Star Medalion
description: A Star-shaped medalion. It seems to be made from a crystal-like material. There is a book card attached to it, belonging to Mr. S.

name: Monkshawon Coin
description: An ancient coin of the Monkshaw tribe imbued with an unknown inscription.

name: Descendant Cloth
description: A torn cloth that's said to have belonged to a king.

name: Meteorite Shard
description: A metallic meteorite shard of unknown purpose.

name: CD Disc
description: Enzymo's CD Disc containing unknown data.

name: Map of the Beyond
description: A very old map that seems to be completely blank.

name: Quartz Crystal
description: A beautiful crystal formation.

name: Quartz Dust
description: Dust made from a beautiful, albeit CRUSHED, crystal.

name: Key Blueprint
description: A blueprint of a mysterious Key.

name: Zeal Ticket
description: A very rare ticket that can be used to travel to Zeal Island.

name: TM103
description: Transposes Dualcell's Code Matrix and transforms it into an Attack Forme.

name: TM104
description: Transposes Dualcell's Code Matrix and transforms it into a Bulky Forme.

name: TM105
description: Does an inverse transpose of Dualcell's Code Matrix and reverts it back to its base form, while restoring HP.

name: TM106
description: The Palm of the God. Gift from the Developer itself.

name: TM999
description: Deletes the opponent.

name: Postgame Card
description: A notepad containing the Postgame Quests Checklist.

name: Rainbow Disc
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. 1/4 of the holder's HP is restored each turn.

name: TM107
description: Depletes foe's PPs, and makes the foe unable to run.

name: Final Diploma
description: One of the 9 Ultimate Items. It does nothing, but it's a proof you have 100%ed the game.

name: Shard of Arceus
description: Believed to be one of the 9 pieces of the Original One, scattered throughout time and space.

name: Yaksha Berry
description: Using it on a Pokémon lowers one of its EVs by 50 points. You get to choose which EV.

name: Ability Capsule
description: A capsule capable of changing the ability of a Pokemon that eats it.

name: Apriplum Dream
description: Special flavor of Apriplum. Heals 50 HP and status. When mushed together they attain a new property.

name: Apriplum Dream Seed
description: It can be planted on loamy soil to grow an Apriplum Blue Tree.

name: Red Ribbon
description: A ribbon obtained as a prize in Snovska Village.

name: Blue Ribbon
description: A ribbon obtained as a prize in Snovska Village.

name: Yellow Ribbon
description: A ribbon obtained as a prize in Snovska Village.

name: Locket
description: A silver Locket. Someone's name is engraved into it.

name: Desert Cookie
description: Deshret's local specialty. It heals all the status problems of one Pokémon.

name: Night Essence
description: A mysterious soluble orb used as a medicine ingredient.

name: Spiky Barb
description: A held item that imbues the holder's next attack with Spikes.

name: Book of Mystics
description: An ancient book imbued with power that greatly boosts Psychic-type moves.

name: Book of Spirits
description: An ancient book imbued with power that greatly boosts Ghost-type moves.

name: Book of Abyss
description: An ancient book imbued with power that greatly boosts Dark-type moves.

name: Dungeon Key
description: A dungeon key.

name: Dungeon Key B
description: A dungeon key.

name: Temple Key
description: A temple key.

name: Green Herb
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It restores any lowered stat in battle. It can be used only once.

name: Zedra 1
description: Fusion stone

name: Zedra 2
description: Fusion stone

name: Zedra 3
description: Fusion stone

name: Lure Tag
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It attracts wild Pokémon if the holder is the first one in the party.

name: DM00
description: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except the Rock, Ground, and Steel types.

name: DM01
description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves.

name: DM02
description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

name: DM03
description: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

name: DM04
description: Boulders are hurled at the target. It also lowers the target's Speed by preventing its movement.

name: DM05
description: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

name: DM06
description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

name: DM07
description: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

name: DM08
description: The user stabs the foe with sharpened stones from below. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

name: DM09
description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.

name: DM10
description: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

name: DM11
description: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the foe's feet. They poison foes that switch into battle.
